summary: parks.ca.gov page + campground brochure + ReserveCalifornia API (all 44 units) + imagery read. Electric 50A written (was blank); max 40 confirmed; dump ($10)/water fill/pay showers/flush; $35 base, electric +$15, premium $65, weekend same; 7-night summer / 15-night winter limit; year-round. Open (no closure). Waterfront: recommend bayview -> coastal walk (reviewer).
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend upgrade, not applied): bayview -> 'coastal walk'. RC tags premium sites 16, 17, 19, 22, 24, 26, 30 (RV, 50A, $65, sold by the night) and tent sites 36-38 'Oceanfront'. On imagery the west-row pads are ~20-40 m behind the sand edge over a foredune/grass band, with Francis Beach (the park's own day-use beach, ~90-100 m wide) between them and the surf; no highway, town or road between. The stored evidence (pads atop a low bluff with a stairway) rules out bayfront, and the single low foredune berm is not a dune field (no coastal dunes), but the coastal-walk test ('an easy walk to the shore of an ocean ... the park's own day-use beach ... may lie between') is met. Sites near 37.4690,-122.4462 (west row).
